Zapata Off-Shore Co.*, 407 U.S. 1 (1972), supports enforcement of such clauses in commercial agreements. However, the non-compete clause (Section 12.1) poses enforceability risks due to its broad geographic scope and 24-month duration. We recommend challenging any attempt to enforce the non-compete on overbreadth grounds while affirming the validity of the forum selection and governing law provisions. No immediate filing is required, but we are prepared to file a motion to compel arbitration if necessary.
